title: NotebookLM Pricing 2026: Free vs Plus vs Workspace Plans

facts.fact: NotebookLM has a free tier that requires no credit card.
facts.quote: Yes, NotebookLM has a free tier with no credit card required.

facts.fact: NotebookLM Plus is not sold standalone; it is only included in a Google AI subscription or a qualifying Google Workspace plan.
facts.quote: There is no way to buy NotebookLM Plus by itself. You are always paying for a bundle - a Google AI plan or a Google Workspace plan

facts.fact: Third-party trackers (not Google) report Plus-level NotebookLM access starting at roughly $4.99 to $19.99 per month, depending on the Google AI tier.
facts.quote: Third-party trackers report Plus-level NotebookLM access starting around $4.99 to $19.99 a month depending on the Google AI tier

facts.fact: The page states that Google has restructured consumer AI plan names and prices more than once in the last year, so any specific dollar figure should be treated as directional.
facts.quote: Google has restructured these consumer AI plan names and prices more than once in the last year, treat any specific dollar figure as directional.

facts.fact: The free tier commonly caps out around 100 notebooks and 50 sources per notebook, according to the page's description.
facts.quote: The free tier commonly caps out around 100 notebooks, 50 sources per notebook, and a capped number of chat queries

facts.fact: Every source on any NotebookLM tier has historically been capped near 500,000 words or roughly 200MB per file, per the page.
facts.quote: Every source, on any tier, has historically been capped near 500,000 words or roughly 200MB per file, regardless of your plan.

facts.fact: Google made NotebookLM Plus a core service inside Google Workspace Business Standard and above, with no additional line item beyond the existing per-seat Workspace price.
facts.quote: Google made NotebookLM and NotebookLM Plus a core service inside Google Workspace Business Standard and above, at no additional line item

facts.fact: Google Workspace Business Standard has historically listed around $14 per user per month for its base plan.
facts.quote: Google Workspace Business Standard has historically listed around $14 per user per month for the base plan

facts.fact: A team on Google Workspace Business Starter does not automatically get Plus-level NotebookLM access.
facts.quote: A team on Workspace Business Starter (the entry tier) does not automatically get Plus-level NotebookLM access

facts.fact: NotebookLM Enterprise is licensed through Google Cloud with its own licensing minimum, and the page states no published list price is available.
facts.quote: sold with its own licensing minimum rather than a simple per-user Workspace add-on

facts.fact: Google gates the free tier by notebook count, sources per notebook, and daily chat queries rather than by feature; core features are available for free.
facts.quote: Google gates the free tier by notebook count, sources per notebook, and daily chat queries rather than by feature.

facts.fact: NotebookLM's pricing is bundled into a broader subscription, which the page describes as unusual compared with most competing AI research and chat tools that sell a standalone monthly seat.
facts.quote: NotebookLM's bundled pricing model is unusual - most competing AI research and chat tools sell a standalone monthly seat instead of folding the product into a broader subscription.
